lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the cold stone floor
Ancient secrets locked behind a heavy door
Dust motes dance in the dying light
Fear and beauty collide in the night

The silence breathes a heavy weight
Time begins to bend and wait

Where the ghosts of the past fly
A crown of thorns, a heart of gold
Let the hidden truths unfold

The colors of the evening fade to gray

A crown of thorns, a heart of gold
Let the hidden truths unfold
